S1a: In Vietnam, only 8.8% of the country's 914,000 small and medium businesses | have a bank loan.
S1b: 75.5% of Vietnamese firms cannot borrow without collateral.
S1c: What they do have is evidence: | bank statements, handwritten ledgers, photos of the shop. | LedgerLens turns that evidence into a credit memo an underwriter can check.
S2a: From the portfolio of demo businesses, we open Reyes Auto Repair, | a repair shop in the Philippines asking for 250,000 pesos.
S2b: The case holds eleven raw documents: | a four-page bank statement, eight handwritten ledger pages and two shop photos.
S3b: Extractor agents, built with Google's Agent Development Kit, | read every page with Gemini 3.8 Flash | and return each value with its page and bounding box. | Then plain Python, not the model, computes the cash flow. | The Analyst drafts the memo, and an independent Challenger tries to break it. | Here, it replays our cached live run.
S4a: Every number in this memo is a link. | Monthly outflow on loan-like transfers: PHP 27,790. | The panel shows sixteen sources, each boxed on the statement.
S4b: Figures inside the text work the same way: | this PHP 14,800 BDO auto loan payment. | Every number links to a document, a page and a box.
S5a: The Challenger never sees the Analyst's prompt. | It runs deterministic checks, then investigates with tools. | Nine objections, three of them critical.
S5b: This shop photo is a byte-identical match to a photo filed by a previous applicant. | And the same ledger page was photographed twice, with the month changed. | Accept.
S5c: This second objection repeats the photo finding, so I dismiss it.
S5d: Two statement months are missing, and the running balance breaks. | Accept.
S5e: It also flags weekly GCash transfers to a likely informal lender, the BDO auto loan, | and ledger cash that is the same money as the deposits, not extra revenue.
S6a: I request more documents, keep the listed conditions, and sign.
S6b: Gemini then writes a plain-language letter to the applicant, in Filipino.
S6c: The audit trail keeps every stage, agent call and human action.
S7a: We tested three demo businesses with 20 planted traps, | in a live Gemini 3.8 Flash run with strict scoring. | LedgerLens caught 18 of 20. | A single prompt on the same documents caught 3 | and wrote 62 unsourced numbers. LedgerLens wrote zero. | A cold run takes about two minutes and about 28 cents per case. | A cached re-run costs nothing.
S7b: Humans decide. | AI shows its work.
S1d: Three steps: read with evidence, challenge, and a human signs.
